traps.note: Count denoiser evaluations on both stacks per render; a mismatch makes the pair VOID. Turbo: 8 per render on both (cfg 1 / guidance 0, no uncond pass).
Studio's 'max' speed tier auto-skips steps (static skip / FBCache); the default tier never skips. State the tier.

Pin DiT, TE and VAE precision on both stacks: Studio's te_quant_auto int8 ConvRot TE differs from the templates' qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled, so the card's formats load qwen3vl_4b_int8_convrot on the baseline UI arm.

The baseline UI draws initial noise on the CPU (torch.manual_seed, bline/sample.py); Studio diffusers draws it with a GPU generator. Same seed != same noise: cross-stack LPIPS needs a shared CPU fp32 noise tensor, otherwise score each stack only against its own bf16.
The baseline UI caches node outputs: every timed request carries a nonce (bline_graphs.apply_nonce) and must show an execution count > 0.

Both Krea 2 templates set the subgraph instance's prompt_enhance input TRUE (instance widgets_values[1]): a TextGenerate node (the Qwen3-VL-4B TE as an LLM, 512 tokens) rewrites the prompt before CLIPTextEncode. Benchmarks switch it off (the krea2 graph has no TextGenerate) and send the raw prompt to both stacks.
The templates carry a LoraLoaderModelOnly (krea2_darkbrush, 0.8) behind enable_lora = false (BlineSwitchNode on_false = the bare UNETLoader model); the graph omits it.

Krea 2 guidance is cond + g * (cond - uncond), enabled when g > 0 (diffusers Krea2Pipeline do_classifier_free_guidance = guidance_scale > 0): Studio guidance 0.0 (Studio ee57a65b4 studio/backend/core/inference/diffusion_families.py:2316 ('krea', 8, 0.0)) = baseline cfg 1.0 (g = cfg - 1, as Z-Image).

Studio: FlowMatch Euler, sigmas linspace(1, 1/8, 8) with fixed mu 1.15 (is_distilled); baseline: euler / simple over ModelSamplingFlux shift 1.15. Same exponential time shift; the simple scheduler samples a 10000-entry table, so expect agreement to ~1e-4, not bit-equal: dump both.
Only relevant if a cell raises cfg above 1: Studio may batch cond + uncond (diffusion_cfg_batch.py:36 lists Krea2Transformer2DModel); evaluation counts are per sample row.

Template TE is qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled in BOTH templates (int8 and fp8), not int8 ConvRot; Studio's family note (Studio ee57a65b4 studio/backend/core/inference/diffusion_families.py:1318-1320) measured layerwise fp8 TE LPIPS 0.110 vs int8 ConvRot 0.047 against bf16 and picked int8. The card's baseline arm runs the int8 ConvRot TE; a template-faithful TE run needs Bline-Org/Krea-2 text_encoders/qwen3vl_4b_fp8_scaled.safetensors staged by a request downloads entry.

Both stacks run int8 weights with int8 matmuls, but the schemes differ: Studio's hosted INT8 DiT is torchao per-row W8A8 without rotation; the template file is int8 ConvRot (Hadamard-rotated, bline_quant). Equal work for a timing pair; expect a cross-stack quality gap from the scheme alone.
Studio's hosted FP8 DiT is torchao per-row Float8 with fp8 activations; the template file is fp8_scaled with attn.gate / attn.wo at full-precision matmul.

Not carded: nvfp4 (Studio diffusion_nvfp4_policy.py has no krea-2 policy, so resolve_policy() is None; the baseline file Bline-Org/Krea-2 krea2_turbo_nvfp4 is Bline-Org only) and gguf (no krea2 arch in BlineUI-GGUF's IMG_ARCH_LIST per bline_graphs.GGUF_REFUSED's notes; unverified for this pin).
